sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is deterministic-valid and faithfully encodes the direct-static requirement: ice-operation applicability selects the applicable branch, the required monitoring procedure is enforced, and escort versus independent operation is coupled to the corresponding escort flag and operating limitations. All properties use the supplied canonical namespace, owners, datatypes, and target class; no matcher activation is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the applicable branch so it does not make both independentOperationLimits and escortedOperationLimits universally mandatory. The requirement states that different limitations may apply by operating mode and that both options are specified only where appropriate; encode the relevant operating-mode/escort applicability alternatives if supported by the declared terms, while retaining the required ice-safety monitoring and applicable escort or icebreaker-assistance requirements. Do not invent a new term or activate the matcher.

Preserve the prior repair instruction: the applicable branch must not make both independentOperationLimits and escortedOperationLimits universally mandatory, but the current unconstrained sh:or is also insufficient because it permits either limits property without encoding which operating mode or escort condition makes that alternative applicable. Using only the supplied terms, make the alternatives conditional on the relevant escort/operating-mode evidence (for example, couple escortRequirementsPresent with the corresponding independent or escorted limitation branch), while retaining iceSafetyMonitoringProcedurePresent=true and the applicable escort-requirements constraint. Do not invent a new term or activate the matcher.

The candidate is deterministic-valid and faithfully encodes the direct-static requirement: ice-operation applicability selects the applicable branch, the required monitoring procedure is enforced, and escort versus independent operation is coupled to the corresponding escort flag and operating limitations. All properties use the supplied canonical namespace, owners, datatypes, and target class; no matcher activation is required.
